narrative:
## Handover Summary — Freight Volume & Revenue Planning

Volume and price assumptions validated by business line and agency region; ML volume proposals accepted for the Q4 peak and overridden where agencies know a customer is changing.

## Key Decisions
• Q4 groupage volume +2.1% in Île-de-France and Rhône-Alpes (ML proposal accepted)
• Q4 FTL volume −4% in Est and Germany; top 20 spot lanes to contracted capacity
• FY2027 GRI 3.5% (SME) and 3.8% (Key Accounts) in the tariff grid

## Recommendation for Cost Planning
Model the subcontracting and fuel plan on the lower FTL volume and include the freight-flow optimisation savings as a cost driver.

signals.title: Freight-flow optimisation saves 2.5% of subcontracted km
signals.source: Freight-flow ML (TMS → Kafka → Snowpipe Streaming) — groupings accepted by freight agents
signals.excerpt: Every 10 minutes the model proposes shipment groupings. Accepted groupings saved about 2.5% of subcontracted km in Q3 2026 (356k km, about €0.58M), which now flows into the subcontracting plan.
